bible.logline: Artisanal Japanese culinary ceremonial matcha preparation ASMR sequence inside a minimalist tea kitchen. Macro 100mm lens tracks vibrant green matcha powder sifting into a textured black ceramic bowl, followed by hot water pouring and a bamboo chasen whisk rapidly frothing dense emerald foam with tactile acoustic clicks.

pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement FilmStockManufacturer, FilmGaugeFormat, GrainPhysicsSpec, HalationPhysicsSpec, GateWeavePhysicsSpec, and FilmStockSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.film_emulation (RMS grain density formulas, halation PSF simulation, gate weave sinusoidal jitter, Kodak/Fuji presets, DaVinci Resolve DCTL shader generator, Avid ALE log, Film Stock JSON export), CRAFT film emulation prompt tokens ([FILM_STOCK: ...]), prompt auditor photochemical verification rules, and an interactive Film Stock Emulation HUD in the dark-room animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: SMPTE 12M Timecode Sync, Digital Clapper Slate & ASC-MHL Offload Manifest Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Production sound mixers, script supervisors, and DIT offload technicians for 'Artisanal Japanese Culinary Ceremonial M' require standardized SMPTE 12M linear/drop-frame timecode synchronization (HH:MM:SS:FF / HH:MM:SS;FF), production clapper slates (Scene/Take/Roll/Filter/FPS), and American Society of Cinematographers Media Hash List (ASC-MHL v2.0 XML) cryptographically sealed offload manifests (MD5, SHA-1, C4) to guarantee picture-to-sound synchronization and dual-destination archival data integrity.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement Smpte12MTimecodeSpec, ClapperSlateSpec, AscMhlHashEntry, AscMhlManifestSpec, and MasterProductionSlateSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.clapper_slate (SMPTE 12M frame conversion, drop-frame alignment, audio sync offset calculation, ASC-MHL v2.0 XML generator, clapper slate CSV log, Avid ALE sound sync log export), CRAFT clapper slate prompt tokens ([CLAPPER_SLATE: ...]), prompt auditor slate verification rules, and an interactive Digital Clapper Slate Console with clapper arm animation in the dark-room animatic.
